wheel.lug_torque: 96 lb-ft (130 N·m) commonly listed for Land Rovers of this era [CONFIRM IN MANUAL]

max_tire.note: LandyZone owners recommend going no bigger on a stock-height, stock-geared truck. The factory 205/80 and 235/70 are almost the same height.

Owners run 33s on lifted trucks. Fit longer springs and extended shocks and lower the bump stops so the body isn't hit at full compression; one owner going from 31 to 33 in still planned a 4.1 ring-and-pinion to restore gearing.
Needs offset wheels to keep a usable turning circle, caster-corrected arms and wide-angle props on bigger lifts, and at least a 4.1 (ideally 4.37) ring-and-pinion.

items.title: Driver airbag can deploy from overheating rotary coupler
items.summary: A chafed cruise-control wire can overheat the steering-wheel rotary coupler and fire the driver's airbag; 54,488 Discoveries and Range Rovers covered.

items.title: Plastic fuel tank stress cracks
items.summary: Stress cracks can develop in the plastic fuel tank; 45,267 Discovery I and Range Rover Classic trucks covered.

items.title: Right front door may not latch fully
items.summary: The right front door can bounce back off its seals instead of latching; 20,889 trucks covered.

items.title: Driveshaft nuts replaced with wrong size at port
items.summary: After a port-of-entry pinion-torque check, driveshafts were refitted with the wrong nuts; 155 vehicles covered.

items.title: Replacement rear driveshaft coupling (service part)
items.summary: Land Rover service part TVF100010 couplings made April–November 2011 were recalled; check any recently replaced rear coupler.

tsbs.title: 300Tdi timing-belt modification kit
tsbs.summary: Like the Defender, the 300Tdi should have the revised timing kit (STC4096L-type) with a flanged crank pulley and spaced idler. Ask for proof.

timeline.change: Unveiled at Frankfurt; UK sales from October, three-door only; 200Tdi and 3.5 V8
Five-door added; V8i with Lucas 14CUX injection
Automatic offered with the 200Tdi; SE pack introduced
Facelift: 300Tdi, 3.9 V8, stronger R380 manual, new dash with airbags. Guides call the 300Tdi the sensible choice, and it commands a premium over the V8
US sales begin, V8 only (3.9 with 14CUX)
US trucks switch to the GEMS-managed '4.0' V8 (same 3,946 cc) for OBD-II
US XD special: 250 built in AA Yellow
Series I ends in the autumn as the Discovery Series II arrives

identify.intro: US Discoveries were all V8s, so a diesel Disco 1 in the US is a private import, and Japanese-market re-imports are common too. Know which engine and market you're buying.

items.head: 200Tdi or 300Tdi?
items.body: The 200Tdi has two V-belts and an aluminium strengthener between block and sump; on the 200Tdi Discovery the injection pump sits high on the right and the turbo low on the left. The 300Tdi has one serpentine belt, no strengthener and a piston-type vacuum pump.

items.head: 14CUX or GEMS V8
items.body: US 1994–95 trucks have the 3.9 V8 with Lucas 14CUX injection; 1996–98 trucks have the GEMS-managed '4.0' (still 3,946 cc) with OBD-II.

items.head: Japanese imports
items.body: Popular because they rot less, but LandyZone members note they're generally automatics with sunroofs. Honda also sold a badge-engineered Disco 1 in Japan as the Crossroad.

items.head: Special editions
items.body: Camel Trophy trucks, the US XD (250 in AA Yellow) and UK Safari, Goodwood and Horse and Hound editions all exist; check trim and paint against the build record.

items.head: Heritage certificate
items.body: The British Motor Museum's Heritage Certificates cover Land Rovers from 1948 on and record build date, engine number, colour and equipment.

values.intro: Still cheap: most sell for around $10,000, 300Tdi manuals bring a little more, and rare special editions sit well above the rest.
values.note: Based on 20 Bring a Trailer sales of Discovery I trucks in 2025–26 ($5,900–38,000, median about $10,000). Three 300Tdi manuals sold for $12,750–14,250; the top result was a 1996 XD TReK 5-speed at $38,000.

paragraphs: Land Rover only sold V8 Discoveries in the US (1994–98 model years), so a 200Tdi or 300Tdi Disco 1 is a gray-market import. Every Series I was built by 1998, so all are now past NHTSA's 25-year line (counted from the date of manufacture). EPA Form 3520-1 code E covers vehicles at least 21 years old in original configuration. Make sure the VIN, chassis number and build date line up.

In California, diesels of the 1997 model year and older are on the smog-check exemption list, but a non-California-certified direct import from 1975 on is supposed to get a CARB Certificate of Conformance after a laboratory test. Confirm with your DMV and CARB before buying a diesel to register there.
